title: Terminal and launcher
intro: raven.commands sets the programs used by the terminal and launcher actions.

blocks.label: Command options
rows: Terminal command. Bound to Super+Q by default.
Launcher command. Bound to Super+D by default.

blocks.text: Use one list entry per argument. Keep spaces within an argument in the same string.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: { "rofi -show drun" } is a single executable name, not a command with arguments.
Names are searched in Raven’s PATH. A name containing / is used as a path; relative paths start from Raven’s working directory. Shell aliases, ~, $HOME, and pipes are not expanded.
A missing or non-executable terminal or launcher rejects the reload. This check does not run the program or verify its arguments, dependencies, or wrapper commands.
